decisions.reason: A dedicated product page and positive customer response suggest results meet or exceed aspirations, so there is little reason to search for alternatives.
A dedicated page indicates satisfactory market presence and no clear shortfall, so the firm is likely to keep it given available slack.
Only a brief mention suggests uncertain results below the firm's usual promotion threshold, but organizational slack allows carrying it while search is limited.
The limited website presence points to uncertain performance, yet the firm's established slack permits keeping the product rather than dropping it immediately.
A niche green waste application and only a brief mention raise uncertainty about meeting aspirations, but slack still supports keeping it for now.
A dedicated page suggests the product is treated as a serious part of the portfolio and likely meets enough of its aspiration to avoid search.
